templates: {speaker} told {listener}: 'That traveler helped us during the last raid.'
{speaker} mentioned to {listener}: 'The outsider has been around a lot lately.'
{speaker} whispered to {listener}: 'I saw the stranger taking crops last night...'
{speaker} said to {listener}: 'That visitor always trades fairly with me.'
{speaker} muttered to {listener}: 'I don't trust that one. Something about them...'
{speaker} told {listener}: 'Did you see? They brought us supplies!'
{speaker} said warmly to {listener}: 'The traveler cured {subject} from that awful curse.'
{speaker} confided in {listener}: 'I feel safer when the outsider is around.'
{speaker} remarked to {listener}: 'Haven't seen that traveler in a while...'
